title: NVDLA BDMA Mixed-Workload Release Signoff
summary: Diagnose interacting BDMA integration regressions, implement saturating per-launch-group workload accounting, and close a clean native release matrix.
taskPrompt: Bring a deliberately regressed NVDLA BDMA integration snapshot to release quality. Diagnose failures across strided 3D copies, mixed MC/CVSRAM command batches, and launch groups; add four read-only workload-accounting registers with wide saturating arithmetic; and pass clean native Verilator signoff without being told the defect locations.
agentMustDo: Use native trace failures and RTL inspection to diagnose the integration snapshot without a disclosed mutation list.
Restore strided, multi-surface, mixed-memory, back-to-back, and group1 behavior without breaking simple transfers.
Implement all four read-only registers and launch-group aggregation semantics inside vmod/nvdla/bdma.
Handle wide arithmetic and saturating accumulation without wrapping.
Run the public release matrix and record root causes, design decisions, and verification evidence in JOURNAL.md.

evaluation: The evaluator overlays the submission on a clean pinned seed and performs a clean native Verilator rebuild. Hidden gates cover asymmetric line strides, independent source/destination surface strides, all MC/CVSRAM directions, back-to-back source switching, group1 completion, single and multi-command accounting, independent group snapshots, and saturation. The deliberately regressed starter earns only a small smoke-test fraction.
